titulo_ja: きく と つたえる (3)

できる.es: poder hacer; ser posible (forma de diccionario)
できる.en: be able to do; be possible (form of dictionary)

あれば.en: if there is; if you have

texto: To say the role or position of someone: **せんせい として、 にほんご を おしえて います** (as a teacher, I teach Japanese).
What follows is the paper, not the person.
To imagine something: **もし にほん へ いく としたら、 なに を します か** (if you went to Japan, what would you do?).
It's used a lot to ask hypothetical questions.
To be almost sure of something: **あした は あめ に ちがいありません** (sure it will rain tomorrow).
It's safer than the real thing.
